chapter: Blackbirds, Carmen Jones and the Ziegfeld Follies
title: Black shows on Broadway in the early 1930s
summary: He says Carmen Jones was the only black show on Broadway then and that Shuffle Along was way before.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: Black shows were pretty big on Broadway at this time, there

Yeah -- lot? not a lot, man. There was only one show on Broadway at the time. "Carmen Jones" was the only black show then. No other black show. Cotton Club was uptown and that's in the background now. Nobody was using that now. And no other colored shows uptown -- uh-uh. What other colored show was there?
No, way early, way early, before "Blackbirds."
